description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing and resolving allowlists, including compiling allowlists, matching candidates, and formatting match metadata.

methods.name: formatAllowlistMatchMeta
methods.description: Formats match information into a string, showing matchKey and matchSource.

methods.name: compileAllowlist
methods.description: Creates a compiled allowlist set from an array of strings, identifying if it contains a wildcard.

methods.name: compileSimpleAllowlist
methods.description: Simplifies and compiles an allowlist from strings or numbers, converting to lowercase strings.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistCandidates
methods.description: Checks if any candidate value exists in the compiled allowlist set, returning an allowed match if found.

methods.name: resolveCompiledAllowlistMatch
methods.description: Resolves a match based on the compiled allowlist, considering wildcards and candidates.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistMatchByCandidates
methods.description: Resolves a match from an allowlist and candidates by compiling the allowlist first.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistMatchSimple
methods.description: Simplified allowlist matching based on sender ID, optional sender name, and allowlist entries.
